modifications.Physiclaw:TestPoint_Pad_D1.0mm_Compact: Derived from the vendored KiCad TestPoint:TestPoint_Pad_D1.0mm. The courtyard diameter is reduced to 1.5 mm. The 1.0 mm copper and mask pad is retained.
modifications.Physiclaw:RF_Module_ESP32-WROOM-32UE: KiCad 10 ESP32-WROOM-32UE manufacturer land pattern; project 12-hole exposed-pad treatment; official Espressif STEP with verified offset.
modifications.TPS1H200A_DGN0008K: TI DGN0008K-C01, drawing 4232899/A. Six 0.20 mm thermal holes, 1.76 × 2.11 mm central paste opening with 0.05 mm corner radius, 1.57 × 1.89 mm mask opening.
modifications.Physiclaw:Texas_UQFN-10_1.5x2mm_P0.5mm: Installed KiCad 10 land pattern checked against TI RSE0010A. Tiny silk marker moved to Fab. Project dimensional preview, not manufacturer mechanical CAD.
modifications.Physiclaw:Button_Switch_SMD_SW_SPST_TS11: XKB TS-1187A-B-A-B. Dedicated 1.00 × 0.75 mm rounded paste windows follow drawing SP-A0162-41 Rev 01. The TL3342 STEP file is a body envelope.
modifications.Physiclaw:Connector_JST_JST_XH_B4B-XH-A_: JST XH, four circuits and 2.50 mm pitch. Finished drill target 1.00 mm with 1.70 × 1.95 mm copper lands.
modifications.Physiclaw:Connector_BarrelJack_BarrelJac: Derived from installed KiCad PJ-102AH footprint; PJ-102BH Rev 1.05 confirms identical 6.0/3.0/4.7 mm terminal locations and 1.0 x 1.6 mm plated slots. Selected MPN PJ-102BH has a 2.5 mm center pin.

models.PJ-102BH-envelope.wrl: Project-authored from Same Sky PJ-102BH Rev 1.05; 2.5 mm center pin, 5.5 mm mating plug. PJ-102AH upstream footprint is the matching mechanical template.
